## Provenance

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- The live Bundibugyo virus disease model. 497 commits, 333 of 425 pull
  requests from the bot account
- Four named authors. Who is accountable for a number an agent produced?

> The model code and analysis were drafted by a language model, then
> reviewed and revised under human oversight.
> The named authors are responsible for that oversight.
:::
::: {.column width="60%"}
```
$ git log --format='%an' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn
 238 Sam Abbott (bot)
 144 seabbs-bot
  50 dependabot[bot]
  40 Sam Abbott
  11 Sam
   7 Sebastian Funk - robot edition
   3 Sebastian Funk
   3 Claude
   1 Samuel Brand
```

::: {.attribution}
[epiforecasts/BVDOutbreakSize](https://github.com/epiforecasts/BVDOutbreakSize)
README and local clone, 2026-09-11 · pull request counts from the
GitHub search API, same day
:::
:::

## Confident, plausible, wrong

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- A script reads counts off a PDF chart
- SitRep 081. Ticks a pixel tall. It read 1,411 cases against a printed
  3,066
- SitRep 087. Grid steps of 25, the script assumed 20. Every count about
  20% low and nothing looked wrong
- Caught because counts for dates already reported changed. They should
  not
:::
::: {.column width="60%"}
![](../figures/comms-digitiser.png){width="100%"
fig-alt="Same bars read on a 20-step and a 25-step axis, 70 versus 87"}

::: {.attribution}
Schematic, this talk. Bars are illustrative · record in
[BVDOutbreakSize `data/README.md`](https://github.com/epiforecasts/BVDOutbreakSize/blob/main/data/README.md),
SitReps 081 and 087, read 2026-09-11
:::
:::

## Who gets to do this

> The people modelling outbreaks where outbreaks happen are the least
> likely to have paid access.
> I do not have a defence for this.
> I am part of the problem.

- £200 a month, from my own pocket. My institution does not cover it
- Who can do this work at all is narrowing. Agents make that worse
